1_rebuttal_completion.description: Run only missing LightNorm cells; exact completed run IDs are skipped.

2_normalizer_search.description: Validation-only screen on horizons 96 and 720 with seed 2021.

3_frozen_backbone_comparison.description: All methods share each dataset-backbone architecture and training setup; module settings are locked before test.

4_timemixerpp_generalization.description: Generalization on TimeMixer++ with internal normalization disabled.

5_lightnorm_tuning.description: Validation-only LightNorm pilot (seed 2021, horizons 96/720) that decides which two tuning axes form the 6-point LightNorm grid.

6_lightnorm_explore.description: Exploratory LightNorm tuning on the test split for a few dev cases (configs/lt_explore.json). Used only to design the tuning strategy and parameter baseline; never part of the validation protocol or the reported comparison.

lt_tuning.fixed: down_ratio and kernel_len as supplied, t_ff 64, affine 1, t_norm 1, sma decomposition; backbone and training unchanged

pilot.station_lr: one ladder step below and above the supplied value; centre = supplied
pilot.decision_rule: Main effect of a factor = mean validation MSE at its high level minus at its low level over the 8 corners, relative to the corner mean, per case and horizon. Keep factors whose |effect| exceeds the seed noise of the supplied setting (3-seed CV of its validation MSE) in a majority of case-horizon pairs, and pick the two with the largest mean |effect|. A factor whose better level is the same in every case-horizon pair is fixed at that level instead of searched. down_ratio {2, 8} is screened only if fewer than two of the three factors qualify. The 6-point grid is (2-level factor) x (3-level factor) and always contains the supplied setting; pilot cases are locked only within that grid.

history: 2026-10-08 use_mlp: rule-based (1 on Weather/Electricity/Traffic, 0 elsewhere); differs from the supplied launchers only on ETTm1 x DLinear (1 -> 0). t_ff is excluded (it acts only when use_mlp = 1).
2026-10-08 station_lr levels restricted to the 1e-n / 5e-n ladder; down_ratio given the lowest priority among the four candidate axes.

grid_revisions: 2026-10-07 DDN: hkernel_len only acts when the wavelet level j > 0, so the supplied j=0 x hkernel_len {3,5} grid held 3 distinct settings. Replaced by kernel_len {7,25,49} x j {0,1} with hkernel_len at the official default 5 (official DDN scripts use j=1 on ETTh1/ETTm1/Weather/Electricity/Traffic).

2026-10-07 FAN: the reference implementation optimizes the frequency predictor with the backbone optimizer and learning rate. Candidates are K x {station_lr, backbone learning_rate}; when both are equal, K x {0.5, 1.0} x station_lr.
